entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original standalone transparent emoji of LUPP, the exact purple Game Design character in the reference. Identity reference: warm tactile 3D plasticine/clay rendering, a compact rounded purple block with two very large slightly asymmetric cream-white googly eyes and dark round pupils; the yellow wooden pencil with silver ferrule and pink eraser is his signature and stays visible. Reaction: welcoming wave with one small rounded purple clay hand, bright alert eyes and a playful slight tilt. Express emotion through eyes, eyelids, subtle purple clay eyebrows and body tilt. Preserve this character's simple shape; no human nose, hair, fur, clothes, human body, or large newly added mouth. A small rounded purple clay hand is allowed only where the gesture requires it. Not a painted elephant or flat vector. The purple character fills about 75 percent of the square canvas, with the complete pencil and any gesture wholly inside the frame and generous clear transparent margins on every side. Readable at 64 px. Genuinely transparent alpha background. No scene, floor, drop-shadow backdrop, checkerboard, text, labels, logos, frame or watermark. Soft warm studio lighting and fine clay texture consistent with the reference. No additional characters. Native high-resolution square PNG.
